claim_scope: Exact root-free attracting cycles for three classical rational root-finding maps on one explicitly specified squarefree quartic, certified by rational interval arithmetic.
integrity: Certificate checks exact rational polynomial identities, interval images, excluded roots and poles, and contractions; public reproducibility code is included. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Quartic and numerical identification of the non-Newton cycles originate in Basti--Cremaschi (2026); contribution is the fully rigorous omitted certificate.
No classification of all quartics, all basins, or global failure at common starting points.
The 2025 Collins--Hunter full paper could not be inspected line by line; priority risk remains.
title: Exact rational certificates for simultaneous Newton, Halley and Schröder failure on one quartic
